CustomField.description: The durable service point identifier, called the ESID in Texas electricity. FSD 5.10.4: it survives meter swaps, so it, not the meter number, is what identifies a service point across a physical device change.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The service point id from the provider, for example the ESID on a Texas electricity account. This stays the same when the physical meter is swapped, so do not change it when a meter is replaced.
CustomField.label: Service Identifier (ESID)
